zones: all zones for the static ability
prospective battlefield entry for the replacement
objects: same physical card resolving from the stack
same logical battlefield incarnation receiving counters
state_reads: distinct colors of mana actually spent to cast
costs: all mana paid for the cast contributes regardless of whether it paid the mana cost, an alternative cost, or an additional cost
timing: cast colors are frozen when payment commits
the counter replacement is prepared before battlefield mutation
choices: only ordinary affected-object replacement ordering choices; Sunburst itself is mandatory
hidden_information: cast payment and the resulting counter quantity are public; unrelated hands remain seat private
apnap: simultaneous affected-object replacement choices use the canonical APNAP coordinator
layers: the counter kind is derived from the printed face while compiling, ignoring type-changing effects as required by CR 702.44a
replacement_effects: each printed instance creates one independently identified affected-object replacement and delegates quantity changes to the canonical counter owner
copy: a spell copy has no cast-payment provenance and receives no Sunburst counters because it was not cast
control_change: the prospective destination controller is the counter placing player
zone_change: entries from zones other than the stack do not qualify
source_leaves: the source and affected object are the same resolving card; the prepared entry transaction pins its physical and logical identity
